releases.notes:
## Tokio for Minecraft

The Fabric mod that connects your Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 world to Tokio. Put the jar in your `mods` folder, with Fabric Loader and Fabric API.

## What's Changed

## New Features

- [ [`b187510`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/b187510361255f145cd761a9ea17cf11f961bffb) ] - **Register /tokio and disconnect when the world closes** _by_ Italo Alfaro
- [ [`002f36f`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/002f36ff6d5dc201ed37b8a8eec9b081a18ef8d1) ] - **Add /tokio connect** _by_ Italo Alfaro
- [ [`d0aa64b`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/d0aa64b9b80c455445ada90734e241fa1156316b) ] - **Run Tokio's commands as the player** _by_ Italo Alfaro
- [ [`0291036`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/029103615265c31920ec08709aa19b6381dfb97a) ] - **Connect to Tokio over its WebSocket** _by_ Italo Alfaro

## Fixes

- [ [`3e4f4f5`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/3e4f4f532a0f02ce9fe325cbab6879fe2cd31aab) ] - **Count setting the time it already is as run** _by_ Italo Alfaro

## Other Changes

- [ [`abd8156`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/abd815627b434e957cfa7abad250554751ba361e) ] - **Describe how to release** _by_ Italo Alfaro
- [ [`6c19b29`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/6c19b29ad517febfa30a267109ad8766ce797bd3) ] - **Publish a release when a version tag is pushed** _by_ Italo Alfaro
- [ [`4f23fbe`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/4f23fbe426f365088a0ec4179f70b648e14e6161) ] - **Say how the world closing and repeated time steps answer** _by_ Italo Alfaro
- [ [`5b5ae33`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/5b5ae33a7efcb6b12e7fce3a1bcbc0ab24954797) ] - **Ignore the logs the tests leave** _by_ Italo Alfaro
- [ [`0968a11`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/0968a1198939e107d2e5ca085a39cfcca76727d2) ] - **Check the connection against a fake Tokio** _by_ Italo Alfaro
- [ [`42ddf5a`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/42ddf5ac43a2a7837dec35a8fc35570a91e7817d) ] - **Start the mod from Fabric's 26.3 template** _by_ Italo Alfaro
